course.text: What is the Empirical Research method?
What quality criteria in research, and why are they important?
What do the terms null hypothesis and alternative hypothesis (H0 and H1) mean?

What are the differences between a speed test and a power test? Name at least one example of a reasonable usage for each of them.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of standardized questionnaires vs. unstructured interviews? When would you use which way of gathering data?
What is the difference between the data view and the variable view in SPSS? When do you use which?
Why is it important to define the variables in SPSS?
What are the differences between mean, mode, and median?
Please explain the link between standard deviation and variance.
What is the meaning of “P-value”?
Describe the T-test independent sample, and ANOVA Test.
What is regression and multiple regression analysis?
Explain the concept of multicollinearity in regression analysis and how it affects the model.
What is MANOVA, and how is it different from ANOVA?
Describe the process of conducting a one-way MANOVA and explain the assumptions it tests.
Explain the concept of "sphericity" in repeated measures ANOVA
What corrective methods are available if the assumption of sphericity is violated?
A non-parametric test is also known as?
What is the difference between a parametric and non-parametric test, and when should each be used?
